description: Reply to a specific message, attaching a reply reference so clients show it as a threaded reply. Use discord_send_message for a standalone message with no reference. Requires the Send Messages permission. Returns the new reply's message ID.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread containing the message.

content.description: Plain-text body of the reply (max 2000 characters).

message_id.description: ID of the message to reply to.

name: discord_reply_message
